name: Exam Paper Classification
prompt: There is a “高考试卷” folder on /root/Desktop, in which Chinese, mathematics, and English exam papers from past years are scattered. Please classify them into the three subjects of Chinese, mathematics, and English within that folder, then split the content of all English exam papers into a new exam paper and save it to /root/Desktop.
